reasoning: A gets the shadows (two UIShadows), the stroke position and unlimited card growth right. Its main flaw is DeviceSafeInsets, which puts the pill in the top bar row, and that is a one-line fix. B keeps the safe area but replaces both shadows with one 9-slice image, leaves the stroke position unset, and truncates long text, which goes against the task.

criteria.note: HudTheme sets Width 360, Padding 16, Gap 8, CornerRadius 16, text 24/16/16, pill Height 44 and coin TextSize 24, all as offsets.
The card uses AnchorPoint (1,0) at (1,-24,0,80) and the pill is centered at Y 20, but `ScreenInsets = DeviceSafeInsets` drops the CoreUI safe area, so the pill sits in the top bar row.

The card has a vertical UIListLayout with Padding 8, UIPadding 16 and AutomaticSize Y; the body is TextWrapped with LineHeight 24/16 = 1.5; the header and progress rows are horizontal with 8 px gaps; the title fills via Size (1,-32) and the track via UIFlexItem Fill.

The card gradient uses the default Rotation 0 on a white base at transparency 0.06; the stroke is 2 px, BorderStrokePosition Center, at 0.86; the fill gradient uses Rotation 90; the coin text has a 2 px Contextual UIStroke.
Two UIShadows with Offset (0,4), Blur 12 at 0.65 and Offset (0,1), Blur 2 at 0.8.
The fill is a native frame sized by spring(Progress/Goal) as a scale width; the pill is a plain fill; only the quest and coin icons are placeholder images.
Main subscribes to HudData.Changed with batch and passes the data in as sources; all checks pass. The top bar overlap from DeviceSafeInsets is a visible defect.
Constants WIDTH 360, PADDING 16, GAP 8, CORNER_RADIUS 16, TITLE_SIZE 24, BODY_SIZE 16, HEIGHT 44 and coin TextSize 24, all as offsets.
The card uses AnchorPoint (1,0) at (1,-24,0,80) and the pill is centered at Y 20 (TOP_MARGIN); the default safe insets are kept.
The vertical list, padding, AutomaticSize Y and 1.5 line height are right, but UISizeConstraint plus TextTruncate cap the title at 2 lines and the body at 4, so a long quest stops growing the card.
The gradient, the 0.06 white base, the Rotation 90 fill and the 2 px coin text stroke are right, but the card stroke never sets BorderStrokePosition Center.
It uses one 9-slice ImageLabel placeholder that merges both shadows (transparency 0.6) and no UIShadow.
The fill is a native frame with a scale width and the pill is a plain 0.5 fill, but the card shadow is an extra image.
Each component subscribes to HudData.Changed itself; it is mounted in GameGui and all checks pass.

strengths: Two UIShadows that match the design
Correct stroke position and gradient rotations
Clean design tokens with all values halved
The card grows without limit for long text
weaknesses: ScreenInsets DeviceSafeInsets puts the pill in the top bar row
Pill transparency 0.4 differs from the design's 0.5

strengths: Simple components that read live data
weaknesses: Shadows are an image, not UIShadows
Truncating long text goes against the task
